name: primitives-effects-shine
title: Shine
blurb: Animated shine effect sweeps across content, continuously or on hover/click.
description: Renders an animated shine/gloss effect that sweeps across child content. Runs continuously, on hover, or on click with customizable color, opacity, and direction.
use_when: Buttons, cards, or premium UI elements where a shine effect adds perceived polish and draws visual attention.
avoid_when: Content already using shine effects where layering might create visual noise.
a11y: Shine effect is purely visual; no impact on semantic content or keyboard interaction.
